changelog: - **Reading a company record is logged** (#2433, under #2396). `GET /api/companies/[id]` now writes a `company.view` `ActivityLog` entry (actor, `targetType: 'company'`, company id, company name as `detail`, IP, user-agent) on a successful read, so "who read this customer record?" is answerable from `/admin/activity`. No new table: the write goes through `logActivity()` and is pruned by the existing `activityLogRetentionDays` window. A repeat of the same read (same action, reader, company, detail and IP) inside the new `viewLogWindowMinutes` setting (default 15, writable via `PUT /api/admin/settings`, not on the form) writes no second row; a read from a new IP, or one made while impersonating (marked `impersonated by <adminId>` in `detail`), is its own row. No value can switch the log off: `0` logs every read, anything past a day is clamped to a day, and a blank or broken value falls back to 15. Nothing reaches the page on failure: a failed setting read uses the default, a failed repeat check records the read, and a failed write is swallowed. A 404 logs nothing; a 403 already logs `authz.scope_denied`. The rule lives dependency-free in `src/lib/viewLogRule.ts` (unit-tested in `scripts/test/view-log-rule.test.mjs`, coverage floor 95) and the Prisma-aware half is `logViewActivity()` in `src/lib/activity.ts`; `detail` is capped to the VARCHAR(191) column so a 191-character company name cannot silently drop the row. Pinned end to end by `e2e/company-view-access-log.spec.ts`.

en: Opening a company record is now recorded in the admin activity log, so admins can see who read which company and when. Repeated views by the same person within a few minutes are recorded once.
tr: Bir firma kaydının açılması artık yönetici etkinlik kaydına yazılıyor; böylece yöneticiler hangi firmayı kimin ne zaman okuduğunu görebiliyor. Aynı kişinin birkaç dakika içindeki tekrarlı görüntülemeleri tek kez kaydediliyor.
de: Das Öffnen eines Firmendatensatzes wird jetzt im Admin-Aktivitätsprotokoll erfasst, sodass Admins sehen, wer welche Firma wann gelesen hat. Wiederholte Aufrufe derselben Person innerhalb weniger Minuten werden einmal erfasst.
